name: Stripe PaymentSheet
description: Create the PaymentIntent on your authenticated server with server-calculated amount/currency and idempotency.

cost.note: Provider charges and quotas depend on your account; consult the official pricing page.

usage: Create the PaymentIntent on your authenticated server with server-calculated amount/currency and idempotency. Inject only its client secret and the publishable key into StripeCheckout. Handle completed/canceled/failed separately; fulfill only after verified server webhooks. Never embed sk_ keys. Use for eligible payments; StoreKit requirements depend on product and storefront.
statusNote: Built into a minimal app with Xcode 27.0 (27A266a) on 2026-10-09.

credentialsNeeded.description: Client-safe pk_ key; never a Stripe secret key
